why: XCFE mode comparisons were string comparisons against hard-coded phases. A lane descriptor with stable ids plus a canonical binary form lets XCFE compare typed fields, and it keeps the decision requirement-driven: a `stochastic` lane is refused only where the requirement asks for reproducible evidence. Nothing here adds a node class — P13-P15 and the frozen 14-class ISA are untouched.

fields.name: reserved
fields.note: always zero; the canonical form forbids a non-zero reserved byte

binary_layout.canonical: one descriptor has exactly one byte string: fixed width, no padding, optional fields encoded as their neutral value, and the trailing reserved bytes always zero
binary_layout.descriptor_ref: sha256 over the 16 canonical bytes, prefixed `sha256:`

modes.note: the mode vocabulary has one source (xcfe_mode.h) and these ids are its canonical binary encoding; the lane asserts the two agree

laws.LS1: a descriptor is closed: its fields are the typed set in lane-sync.ebnf, and every integer field is bounded by its declared width
laws.LS2: the binary form is canonical: fixed little-endian layout, optional fields encoded as their neutral value, so one descriptor has exactly one byte string and the reserved bytes are always zero
laws.LS3: comparison reads typed fields, never source strings, and never reconstructs a descriptor from a lane's prose
laws.LS4: determinism compatibility is requirement-driven: a mode is refused only when the requirement asks for a flag the lane does not carry, so a stochastic lane stays compatible wherever reproducible evidence is not required
laws.LS5: effect compatibility is symmetric: every required effect must be present and no forbidden effect may be present
laws.LS6: Admitted = ExistingXCFEAuthority AND LaneCompatible; the guard can turn an authorized candidate into a rejection and never the reverse
laws.LS7: a decoded descriptor is evidence, not permission: unpacking an ASXG/SCXQ2 payload grants nothing, and the guard never sets commit_authorized
laws.LS8: the lane descriptor stays authoritative and the guard result names the descriptor it judged
laws.LS9: the producer discriminator is compared first: a requirement that names a source accepts only that source, and Unspecified accepts any producer
laws.LS10: a phase is compared only for a lane kind that declares @phase; a kind without one is never given an invented phase, and a kind with one is never allowed to dodge the check
laws.LS11: descriptor validity does not mean the referenced capability exists: as docs/ASXG-LANE-DESCRIPTORS.md states, a structurally valid descriptor can leave its capability unresolved, and a runnable lane must also resolve every program and phase before it becomes an executable candidate

transport.binary_descriptor: normalised lane properties for comparison; no execution required
transport.bytecode: encodes comparison instructions when static field matching is insufficient
transport.asxg_scxq2: may transport the compiled representation under their existing contracts, and must not introduce a competing authority system
transport.law: unpacking a payload is separate from granting execution permission

invariants.isa_untouched: P13-P15 and the closed 14-class XCFeNodeClass set are unchanged

producers.law: lane sync is one comparison mechanism over several lane vocabularies; sharing a comparison form does not make two lanes the same kind of thing

phase_bearing.law: a phase is compared only for a kind that declares @phase; HistoryLane and EnvironmentHypothesisLane declare none, so a phase is neither invented for them nor allowed to dodge the check for a kind that bears one

NGramLane.note: orders 1-3 are probability references, 4+ are retrieval references; a key reference is an address and asserts no truth

PhaseLane.note: binds a plan step to a registered Micronaut, program and canonical phase with @requires_admission: true

HistoryLane.note: scope and provenance records; no phase to compare

EnvironmentHypothesisLane.note: hypothesis reference and field/micronaut/program refs; no phase

runtime_graph.note: a (address, phase) vertex of G_runtime = Q3 □ C6; the phase is the theta coordinate

operator.note: a map/filter/reduce instance; phase comes from the program descriptor it belongs to

xcfe_mode.note: a mode applied inside a phase; the phase is the context it applies to

producers.authority_holder: the producer keeps its own vocabulary and its own validator; the canonical descriptor is a comparison projection and never replaces the source record

related_authorities.note: asxg.lanes.v1 stays frozen and is versioned independently; lane sync compares projections of it and of the other producers, and packing/unpacking/validation still do not execute a lane
related_authorities.asxg_lane_fixtures_used_by: src/tests/test_lane_plan.cpp (both valid fixtures sync; all six invalid fixtures are refused)

plan_sync.subject: an asxg.lanes.v1 bundle (docs/ASXG-LANE-DESCRIPTORS.md)
plan_sync.law: the same canonical descriptor and the same guard judge a plan's PhaseLanes and a Q3 □ C6 movement; the producer discriminator keeps them distinct

bundle_rules.interpreted: a bundle declaring @interpreted true is refused: packing, unpacking and validation do not execute a lane
bundle_rules.lanes: at least one declared lane, and at least one PhaseLane: a bundle of evidence lanes is not a plan (no_phase_lanes)

step_rules.phase: canonical C6 phase; Chen/Ch_en are aliases of Ch'en, an unknown token is refused
step_rules.order: one execution, so the ladder is forward-only and cannot wrap (phase_not_forward)
step_rules.commit_effect: only a Xul step may carry the commit effect; the per-step requirement forbids it elsewhere
step_rules.guard: each step is judged by lane_guard against a reproducible PhaseLane requirement, and against the consumer requirement when one is supplied

edge_rules.transitions_to: PhaseLane -> PhaseLane, adjacent in C6 order
edge_rules.other: an unknown relation is refused rather than ignored
edge_rules.endpoints: every edge endpoint must resolve to a declared lane

plan_sync.does_not_resolve_capability: descriptor and plan validity still do not prove a referenced capability exists (LS11): every program and phase must resolve against its manifest before the plan is an executable candidate
